notes: SeedClock (SCLOCK) targets Ethereum mainnet (chain ID 1). Deploy these two contracts consecutively in one atomic factory transaction, with no untrusted call between them: SeedClock's constructor consumes RoyaltyDistributor's transient binding capability, which also checks that the binding caller is a fresh contract created by the same factory that created the distributor. Both use $owner as the immutable treasury, receiving the 55 reserve NFTs. Neither contract has an owner, pause, upgrade, extra mint, royalty setter, or withdrawal administrator; the factory is recorded only as the expected deployment caller for the one-time binding. No post-deployment initialization or funding is required. SeedClock caps supply at 5555 and opens the remaining 5500 to free minting by wallets holding at least one whole IMD (10^18 base units of 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7), with a lifetime public mint limit of five per wallet. ERC-2981 royalties are fixed at 690 bps to RoyaltyDistributor; secondary transfers use the fixed OpenSea strict transfer validator. The distributor snapshots holder balances on each ETH receipt, syncs mainnet WETH before every mint or transfer, and snapshots other ERC-20s when anyone calls syncToken. Claims are pull-based and settle at most 64 balance segments per call; rounding remainders are carried into the asset's next receipt rather than paid to any holder. Animated SVG rendering and deterministic timestamp-based seed derivation are internal to SeedClock.
